analysis.title: Owens Corning (OC): 3Q26 First Take
key_insights: OC reported 3Q26 adj. EPS of $2.44 vs GS estimate $3.24 and FactSet consensus $3.07. Adj. EBIT margin was 12.7%, 282bps below the GS model, which cost $0.67 of EPS.
Revenue fell 7% YoY vs GS estimate of -3%, which cost $0.17 of EPS. One-time adjustments added $0.04, share count $0.02 and interest expense $0.01. Non-controlling interest cost $0.04.

Roofing led the weakness. Elevated channel inventories met a rapid rise in transportation costs and broader inflation, especially in oil-based raw materials. New home construction also moderated. Cost controls, efficiencies and productivity gains partly offset this.

4Q guide: sales from continuing operations expected to decline ~2% YOY at the mid-point vs GS estimate of +7%. Adj. EBITDA margin guided to 11% vs GS estimate of 16.2%. Management expects conditions to persist, including limited realization of recent price increases.
Roofing sales fell 16% YOY vs GS estimate of -7% as industry shipments fell 13%. Adj. EBITDA margin contracted 542bps YOY to ~28.7%, 187bps below GS forecast.
Doors revenue fell 11% YOY vs GS estimate of -7%. Adj. EBITDA margin compressed ~510bps YOY to ~5.2%, 492bps below the GS model.
Insulation revenue rose 6% YOY vs GS estimate of +5%. Adj. EBITDA margin fell ~105bps YOY to ~21.5%, 57bps below the GS model.

Net debt/EBITDA was 2.5x, up from 2.4x sequentially and 1.9x a year ago, with $179mn of cash. OC repurchased $275mn of stock in the quarter with 8.8mn shares left on the authorization, and reduced debt by $299mn. 2026 capex guide held at ~$800mn vs $824mn in 2025.

GS keeps a Neutral rating with a $128 12-month price target (8.7% upside from $117.76), based on 7.3x Q5-Q8 EBITDA. GS lists the call topics: roofing channel inventories, resi fiberglass insulation utilization, commercial/industrial insulation demand, Europe, price/cost given oil moves, doors integration and cost reduction.

market_movers.rationale: GS kept Neutral and a $128 target after a 3Q EPS miss and a 4Q guide well below its estimates. Valuation is 7.3x Q5-Q8 EBITDA.

sector_views.rationale: Roofing and doors weakened on elevated channel inventories, higher transportation and oil-based raw material costs, and moderating new home construction.

earnings_insights: OC 3Q26 adj. EPS reported $2.44 vs GS estimate $3.24 and FactSet consensus $3.07, reported 11/4/2026.
3Q26 adj. EBIT margin reported 12.7%, 282bps below the GS estimate. Revenue reported down 7% YOY vs GS estimate of -3%.
4Q26 guide: sales from continuing operations ~-2% YOY at the mid-point vs GS estimate +7%. Adj. EBITDA margin 11% vs GS estimate 16.2%.

Segment results reported for 3Q26: Roofing sales -16% YOY (GS est -7%), adj. EBITDA margin ~28.7%. Doors sales -11% YOY (GS est -7%), margin ~5.2%. Insulation sales +6% YOY (GS est +5%), margin ~21.5%.
GS estimates for OC: FY26E EPS $9.80, FY27E $10.70, FY28E $14.60. 4Q26E EPS $1.40 and 1Q27E $1.48 were set before this print.
risk_factors: Upside risks to GS Neutral rating: ability to realize price, company initiatives landing faster, and effective capital allocation including shareholder returns.
Downside risks: weaker demand for big ticket repair and remodel, rising raw material costs (notably energy related) that OC cannot pass through, and increased competition if peers seek share.
Elevated roofing channel inventories, with no severe weather into year-end to clear them.
Housing starts moderating, which lowers utilization in resi fiberglass insulation.
